text: Aoife's son Cillian starts primary school on 2 September 2026. She's more nervous than he is, apparently. I should text her that morning. She also said her mother-in-law wants to come along for the drop-off, which Aoife is not thrilled about, and that Cillian has already decided he hates the uniform. Ask her afterwards how the first week went.
Reza lives in Walthamstow now, works in procurement for the council. Wife is called Mina, two girls.
Ruby graduates from Leeds on 14 July 2027. Her mum is flying over from Perth for it and staying the whole week afterwards.

Coffee with Mei. Her daughter Lily has her Grade 5 piano exam on Saturday and has been practising every night. Mei says Lily is terrified of the sight-reading bit. Don't forget to message Lily's good luck through Mei the day before.
Imani's brother Kwame got into Edinburgh for medicine. Whole family is thrilled.

Tobi and his partner Sara are moving to Bristol in March 2027. He's already lined up a job at the hospital there, starting a week after the move, and Sara is hoping to go freelance. They've found a flat near Clifton but haven't signed yet. Tobi said the hardest part will be leaving his dad, who has been on his own since his mum died in 2024.
Need to pick up the dry cleaning before Thursday and book the car in for its MOT.
Aneesh mentioned his dad had a fall last week. He's home now but still quite shaky. I must call Aneesh at the weekend to see how they're getting on.
Aurelio works for a vineyard importer in Shoreditch. Grew up near Verona, still has a flat there that he rents out.

Deepa's twins, Anaya and Rohan, sit their GCSEs next summer. She says Rohan is coasting and Anaya is the opposite, revising until midnight and getting herself in a state about it. Deepa is worried she'll burn out before the mocks in January 2027. Her husband Vik thinks a tutor might help with maths. Worth checking in with Deepa after the mocks to see how Anaya did.
Sean's little girl Orla lost her first tooth yesterday. He showed me a photo at lunch.
Jakub is allergic to shellfish, and his wife Ewa is vegetarian. Useful for the dinner.

Sam (Samantha, but nobody calls her that) has her driving test on 9 December 2026. Third attempt. She's really anxious. Remind me to text Sam good luck the night before and ask how it went the next day.
Alessia's grandmother turns ninety on 3 November 2026. The whole family is going back to Naples for a party that weekend.

Talked to Rahul about his PhD viva. It's pencilled in for late February 2027, and his supervisor Dr Fischer thinks he's ready, though Rahul clearly doesn't believe it. He's barely sleeping and keeps rewriting his conclusion. His girlfriend Giulia has banned thesis talk at dinner. I need to send him a message the day before the viva, and take him for a pint the week after, whatever happens.
Sophie and Dan's housewarming was meant to be this Saturday but they've called it off; the boiler packed in and the house is freezing. They'll rearrange for the new year.
Abdi's eldest, Hodan, started secondary school this term and is already in the football team. He's very proud.
Florin lives in Croydon with his partner Ricardo and their dog Biscuit. Florin teaches chemistry at a sixth form college.
Matilda's husband had his knee operation on Monday. She said the first night was rough but he's on crutches and moving about. I should send them a card this week.

Arjun graduated! Masters in data science, distinction. Ceremony was on Friday and his parents came down from Leicester. Need to send him congratulations properly, not just a thumbs up on the group chat.

Yetunde's mum, Mrs Adeyemi, is coming over from Lagos for Christmas and staying until mid-January 2027. Yetunde is excited but stressed about getting the spare room ready in time. Her mum hasn't been to London since 2019 and Yetunde wants to take her to see the lights on Regent Street and to her son's carol concert on 16 December 2026. She's also worried about her mum's blood pressure on the long flight.
Carmen mentioned she's been learning Portuguese on her lunch breaks. Her partner's family is from Porto.
Ciara's son Finn has his first nativity play on 11 December 2026. He's a sheep. She asked if I wanted to come along and I've said yes.
Fiona works at the Royal Infirmary as a midwife, mostly night shifts. Lives in Morningside with her sister Kirsty.
Divya's little boy Kabir has his eleven plus results due on 31 October. She's been on edge all month. I need to ring her that evening, whatever the result.
Sara's niece Leila turned eighteen at the weekend. Sara gave her driving lessons as a present.
Giulia is pregnant again, due in April 2027. She told me today but they're keeping it quiet until the twelve-week scan next week.
Mia's older brother Theo is doing a year in Japan teaching English. Mia says he loves it and might stay on.

Chantal starts her new job at the BBC on 2 November 2026. Her mum is minding the baby on weekdays from then on. Remind me to text Chantal the evening before to wish her luck, and to ask how the first week went a week after.
Ricardo and Juan are celebrating ten years together on 18 November. They're going to Lisbon for a long weekend. Juan hinted that Ricardo wants a decent espresso machine.
Juan is from Seville originally and works as an architect. He's the quiet one of the pair.
Note to self: renew passport before March 2027 and find out whether the photo booth at the station still works.
Aoife's husband Declan is training for the Dublin marathon at the end of October. She says his knees are complaining but he refuses to stop. Ask her how he got on afterwards.
Reza's daughter Parisa got her first school report today. Top marks in reading, a note about talking too much in class. He was laughing about it.
Ruby, or Rubes as her sister calls her, is the one who works in theatre lighting. Lives on a narrowboat near Hackney Wick.
Mei's dad has dementia and has just moved into a care home near Cambridge. She's finding it really hard. Visiting him every Sunday. I should take her out for lunch soon, just to give her a break.

Imani's graduation is on 5 December 2026 at the Barbican. Her parents, her brother and her nan are all going, and there's a dinner at a Lebanese place afterwards. She said she'd send me the photos. I'd like to get her something small, maybe a nice pen; she mentioned hers had been nicked from the library. Must order it the week before.
Tobi's mum is having her cataract surgery on 12 November 2026. He's taking the day off to drive her and staying over the night after. Text him on the 13th to ask how she is.
Aneesh is vegan, doesn't drink, and supports Arsenal with a slightly alarming intensity.

Long chat with Deepa on the phone. Vik's company is making redundancies and his review meeting is on Wednesday. She's trying to stay calm for the kids but they're both obviously worried. If it goes badly they might have to look at moving back near her parents in Birmingham. I should check in with her on Thursday, the day after the meeting.
Sean and his wife Niamh are expecting their third. Due 20 March 2027. Niamh has had awful morning sickness this time round.
Jakub's son Tomasz starts nursery on Monday. Jakub is doing the drop-off that morning and his wife is collecting.
Sam's dog Pepper has been limping for a week. Vet on Tuesday.
Alessia is the HR manager at the hotel group. She lives in Clapham and has a cat called Gnocchi, which feels about right.

Rahul's sister Priya got engaged over the weekend. The wedding is likely to be in Mumbai in December 2027. He's already dreading the flights. His parents want everyone there for the full week of celebrations, and Rahul has only just started a new job, so he's not sure he can get the time off. Priya's partner, Aurelio Moreau, is apparently brilliant at karaoke.
Dentist moved to 10 November 2026 at 8:30. Leave early because of the roadworks.
Sophie's eldest, Grace, got her A-level results back in August and is now at Exeter studying geography. Sophie says the house is far too quiet.
Abdi's wife Fadumo is doing her nursing finals in May 2027. He's taking on more of the school runs until then.

Florin was saying his brother Mihai has just had a little boy, born on Sunday. First grandchild on that side, so his parents are over the moon. I should get something for the baby, maybe the knitted animals from that shop by the station.
Matilda used to work with me at Baker and Morris. She left to retrain as a primary teacher and now teaches Year 2 in Lewisham.

Arjun mentioned his younger sister Nisha has her university interview at Oxford on 8 December 2026. She's been preparing for weeks and is very nervous. Arjun is driving her up the day before. Remember to message Arjun that evening to ask how it went.
Yetunde's son Daniel is learning the drums. Neighbours apparently less keen.
Carmen's daughter Lucía has her first ballet show on 29 November 2026. Carmen is making the costume and has no idea what she's doing.
Ciara rang. The christening on Sunday is off because the baby has chickenpox. They'll try again in the new year.

Fiona mentioned it's her parents' fortieth anniversary on 2 November 2026. She and Kirsty are organising a surprise meal the day before, at the Italian place they had their wedding reception in. Fiona asked if I'd help with the playlist. I said I would.
Divya and her husband Neil have just bought a house in Harrogate. They move on 15 December, right before Christmas, which Divya says was a terrible idea.
Sara Ito works in the finance team at the university. Her partner is a sound engineer and they live above a bakery in Stoke Newington.
Quiet one today. Batch cooked for the week and sorted the spare room. Nothing to note really.
Giulia's father-in-law passed away on Thursday. The funeral is in Turin on 4 November 2026 and she flies out two days before. Need to send flowers to the house and check in with her once she's back.
Mia's son Leo took his first steps this morning! She sent a video. Remind me to ask Mia next week whether he's walking properly yet.
